newsitem.title: USA: Dell ships mid-range Pentium Pro server.
newsitem.headline: Dell ships mid-range Pentium Pro server.

text.p: Dell Computer Corp said on Thursday it started shipping its Dell PowerEdge 4100, a midrange Pentium Pro processor-based network server, with a starting price of $6,199.
Dell also said it would provide Microsoft Windows NT Server 4.0 or 3.51 at no additional charge to customers who bought any Dell PowerEdge server through the end of the year.
"Servers achieved the highest rate of unit growth of any Dell product line in the second quarter," said Michael Lambert, senior vice president of Dell's server group.
The PowerEdge 4100 is an enterprise-capable server for distributed application environments, Inter/Intranet servers, mail messaging and database applications, Dell said.
It was available immediately in single- and dual-processor Pentium Pro configurations running at speeds of 180MHz or 20OMHz, the company said.
In independent benchmark testing, the PowerEdge 4100 achieved record-breaking price and performance ratings from Client/Server Labs and AIM Technology, Dell said.
